speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests; to begin our investigation, have you noticed any jaundice, dark urine, or pale stools recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) is less likely given the age and sex, but the combination of pruritus, fatigue, abnormal LFTs, and history of ulcerative colitis strongly suggests Inflammatory Bowel Disease-associated Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC). Please confirm if you have had any recent blood draws showing elevated Alkaline Phosphatase, and if so, what were the specific values? Also, have you noticed any change in bowel habits or stool consistency recently?
